name: com.gamecore.rules.gameplay
description: Unity-free rules of the gameplay plugin library (P1.1). Runtime/Entities: the pure alive/variant/visibility/scale transitions of an authored entity. Runtime/World: the region residency state machine (Unloaded, Loading, Resident, Unloading), the portal graph and travel validation. One engine-free assembly, GameCore.Rules.Gameplay, built unchanged under plain dotnet (dotnet/src/GameCore.Rules.Gameplay).
